spans.s: स्त्रीप्रत्यय (1) affixes added to the masculine base of a word to show the sense of the feminine, such as आ in टापृ, डापू and चापू and ई in ङीपू, ङीषू and ङीनन्. See
to 8l. (2) name of a section of Bha- ttoj's Siddhantakaumudi which gives the affixes added for the formation of a feminine base.
